VERDICT write_paths: the declared write paths are reckon/crew/reports.py, reckon/crew/prompts.py, tests/test_a_manifest_names_its_figure.py, docs/evidence/fragments/a-landing-is-recorded-once/alro-s2.html and docs/figures/a-landing-is-recorded-once/alro-s2; git diff --stat over bb45282b..d545600d3c touches exactly reports.py, prompts.py, the test file and the fragment; the figure directory is claimed but carries no figure, which the rule permits.

VERDICT diff: read commit by commit against bb45282b; 54b35a5808 adds the check, the _revision_is_committed helper, the prompt clause and the test file (352 insertions), and d545600d3c adds the landing fragment; no path outside the declared scope and nothing the goal does not imply.

FINDING reckon/crew/reports.py:1957 non-blocking: the commit half reads only paths the head adds since base, because _committed_paths_added_since uses git diff --diff-filter=A, so a node that redraws a figure already present at its base is refused as not carried although its commit carries the path.
